analyzed_vuln.description: InverseBlitter tracks span state in shifted coordinates (fFirstX/fLastX/fPrevX are set as clip << shift), but prepost() forwards fPrevX and invWidth directly to the wrapped blitter via blitH() without validating that these values remain within the destination device bounds. With malformed fuzzed path/canvas state, this can produce out-of-range x/width, which propagates into SkARGB32_Blitter::blitH() and then SkBlitRow::Color32(), where vectorized loads read from an invalid src/dst pointer (crash at skvx::Load in blit_row_color32).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered in the api_raster_n32_canvas harness when fuzzed drawing commands create an inverse-filled path scan where InverseBlitter computes a final inverse span (prepost(..., false)) whose x/width are invalid for the target raster device. Data flow: fuzz input -> fuzz_canvas drawPath -> SkScan::FillPath inverse path walk -> InverseBlitter::prepost/blitH emits unchecked span -> SkARGB32_Blitter::blitH passes pointer to SkBlitRow::Color32 -> SIMD Load reads wild address. Requires inverse-fill path processing and span coordinates that escape clip/device expectations.
